method: Direct visual inspection of final-video beat contact sheets and selected full-resolution rendered frames. Movement data and every-frame pixel checks are separate evidence.

observations: Five cast members, shy hiding pose, wind-driven pile and return visible.
Frame 385 flash is intentional; framed snapshot appears at 17-20 seconds.
Korean title/captions legible and outside character faces.
Star detaches, sun jumps, raindrop slides across ice, star returns to sleeping cloud.
Transition repair is reflected in baked root trajectories and actual rendered output.
Final sleep caption and original audio stream present.
Heat/rain/ice effects, plant growth and pink flower are visible.
All five principal body colors change to pollen yellow in the final gag.
Flower is staged in front of Solsol; intended overlap retained.
Final giant cloud is an intentional closeup and crop, with the nap-weather caption readable.
Teal/pink bubble rim now visible against the stage.
Snow crystal retraction, cloud approach, burst and five descending bubble hats visible.
Final hat scene also checked using the bridge camera preview.

limits: Frame-based visual review; no claim of subjective audio audition. Stylized procedural animation, not fluid or cloth simulation.
